title: Unit Event — Whip Yourself into Shape! — Episode8 Standing Tall

meta.Event Outline: An psyches herself up to work on the task she's been given, but there's hesitation in her singing. When she realizes that her unease over Kohane is causing the problem, An calls her out to Vivid Street to settle things once and for all.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Man, the battle's over, but everyone's still bouncing off the walls...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
That day when we battled against Taiga...
I became convinced that there was no way for us to win.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: It felt like I was on my motorcycle smashing head-first into a semi.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
But...
I'm not sure I should've given up so easily.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We originally began singing because we really admired this one senior of ours who was chasing after an impossible dream that others laughed at.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: But we decided to stop chasing the impossible... We said, “We'll never succeed, so why bother?”

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: But that was clearly just an excuse.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: The prospect of not winning, of losing that badly again... We haven't been able to shake that fear.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: It started to feel like a fact we couldn't change.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: She overcame the fear within herself.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So, you guys, how about we quit running already...?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We need to keep fighting until we find a way to win.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
That's our mission.
That's why we're called EVER.

rows.Speaker: EVER Member
rows.Line: We gotta get back on track...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Will you let us back into your group?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Looks like things are starting to settle down.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to go beyond Nagi's dream!

rows.Speaker: Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Wait, you don't know?
She was a member of RADder.

rows.Speaker: Local Musicians
rows.Line:
So, that means going beyond RADder...
Like, surpassing RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to take her hopes and dreams and go where she couldn't.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to take what she entrusted me with that night and make her proud.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want you all to join us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, you're coming with us whether you like it or not!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nagi's dream! All of your hopes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're gonna carry them with us!
We're gonna take them to heights you can't imagine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna show all of you something that you couldn't see even at RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: To see where you all go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this with me today, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was able to overcome all the doubt and fear I've been feeling up until now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What we did today made me want to get even better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
Do you think you'll be able to accomplish your task, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's going to be really hard...
But I think I will be able to now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In that case, I'll be looking forward to seeing some good results, partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys...!
Thanks for coming to watch us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We should be the ones thanking you.
They decided to come back because of what you just did.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Your battle helped open our eyes.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you all again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Likewise!
Thanks so much for deciding to come back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Next time, we're for sure gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!
